name: Aldric
lore: A steadfast knight sworn to guard the Greenwood road.

name: Lyra
lore: A keen-eyed archer who never misses twice.

name: Pip
lore: An eager apprentice whose spells sometimes work exactly as planned.

name: Sister Maren
lore: A healer from the mountain abbey.

name: Vex
lore: A rogue who fights for coin and

name: Seraphine
lore: A paladin whose shield has never broken.

name: Kael Wildheart
lore: A tracker raised by the forest itself.

name: Zara Stormcaller
lore: She speaks and the sky answers.

name: Fennick
lore: A bard whose songs make cowards brave.

name: Drakon
lore: The last rider of the red dragons.

name: Brannoc Ashward
lore: A village watchman who walked out of the Ashfall carrying three children and a door for a shield.

name: Ilsa Cinderwake
lore: She survived the dragon's last breath. Now the ash answers when she calls.

name: Orin the Unslept
lore: A gravedigger who dreamed of the Hollow Gate and has not slept since.

name: Hesk Tidebreaker
lore: The harbor-master who held the sea wall alone the night Ys-Marrow drowned.

name: Maelis of the Reef
lore: Half her armor is coral that grew over her while she slept beneath the waves.

name: Captain Rook Vane
lore: A Black Tide deserter. He plundered the drowned city, then saw what still lived in it.

name: Ottla Grimm
lore: She hunts things the size of churches with a rope and a prayer.

name: Sir Calder the Drowned
lore: He died on the sea wall. The tide sent him back, and he does not know why.

name: Wren Saltfeather
lore: A cliff-runner who reads storms in the flight of gulls.

name: Tamsin Reef-Eye
lore: She spears eels in black water by the glow of their own hunger.

name: Ebba Lampwright
lore: Keeper of the last lighthouse on the coast. Her lamp burns for the dead now.

name: Nerys of the Deep
lore: A sea-witch who bargained with the Tide Mother and lost something she will not name.

name: Aurek Brine
lore: He studied the drowned library until the ink began to read him.

name: Lirael, Silent Siren
lore: A siren who cut out her own song so it could never lure sailors again. She sings with her hands.

name: Father Osk
lore: The drowned chapel's last priest. He still rings the bell below the waves.

name: Oakheart Durn
lore: A Wildwarden who let the Elder Tree grow into his skin.

name: Sabine Thornblade
lore: A fey-court duelist exiled for winning a duel she was meant to lose.

name: Grund of the Briar
lore: Raised by bears, ruined by the blight, saved by rage.

name: Fenna Mosswhisper
lore: She speaks with the moss, and the moss tells her where enemies will step.

name: Ysolde Hawkmother
lore: Her hawks have eaten the eyes of three blight-lords.

name: Ashe Lowbough
lore: Fletches arrows from blighted wood. They spread what they carry.

name: Toma Antlerborn
lore: Rides the last white stag. The Rot Stag was its brother.

name: Quill of the Gloaming
lore: A fey archer whose arrows arrive slightly before they are loosed.

name: Morra Nettlecrown
lore: A blight-witch who turned on her coven when they fed children to the Rot Stag.

name: Lumen Sporecaller
lore: Glowing spores drift from her sleeves. Where they land, wounds close or flesh rots.

name: Elder Saelith
lore: The oldest Wildwarden. She remembers when the Elder Tree was a seed.

name: Pell Fawnsong
lore: A shepherd whose flute calms beasts and, lately, the blighted.

name: Vitrum
lore: A glass golem of the Arcanum whose maker is long dead. It still guards the door.

name: Kaveh Dune-Shield
lore: He leads caravans across the glass and has buried more travelers than he has delivered.

name: Asha Glasssting
lore: An assassin of the Sand Courts who tips her blades with scorpion venom.

name: Rashid the Unbound
lore: A djinn bound to a sword by Ilvane. Freed by the party, he serves by choice.

name: Idris Longsight
lore: He can hit a coin across the dunes at noon. He charges extra for the coin.

name: Seren Glasswright
lore: She spins storm-glass, the stuff the fourth Seal was made of.

name: Old Hamid
lore: A blind sand-seer who sees the Hollow coming in every grain.

name: Zaynab Flamestep
lore: She dances on hot glass barefoot. The glass gives up first.

name: Archivist Teodor
lore: He kept the Arcanum's library through the betrayal and will not forgive Ilvane.

name: Nadira the Hollowed
lore: Ilvane's apprentice. The Hollow took her left hand; she uses the hole.

name: Mother Yara
lore: She keeps the last oasis. Every traveler drinks, even enemies, once.

name: Pim Starcounter
lore: Counts the stars every night. Lately there are fewer.

name: Hrolf Half-Giant
lore: His mother was a frost giant. He is the small one.

name: Sigrun Icewall
lore: Shield-maiden of the north wall. Never retreated; once advanced by accident.

name: Ulfgar Bloodaxe
lore: A clan berserker who swore a blood-oath to the party. The clan wants it back.

name: Kari Wolfsister
lore: She runs with a wolf pack the clans pretend not to see.

name: Bjorn Ironskald
lore: A skald who fights with an axe and sings the deaths he causes.

name: Astrid Rimeblade
lore: Her sword is cold enough to stop a heart. She has checked.

name: Jarl Haldor
lore: The jarl who demanded the blood-oaths. He paid his own first.

name: Eira Snowstalker
lore: White furs, white bow, white breath. You hear the arrow, then nothing.

name: Gunnar Trapwright
lore: Lays traps for wendigo. He has caught three, and a jarl.

name: Vala Rimewitch
lore: A seeress who speaks to the frozen Titan. It speaks back, slowly.

name: Thyra Runecarver
lore: Carves runes into shields. Some are prayers, some are threats.

name: Granny Ylva
lore: She keeps the hearth fire of the clans alive, feeds anyone and scolds everyone.

name: Commander Brega
lore: Last commander of the Order of the Bulwark. The Order is her and four recruits.

name: Dorn Anvilborn
lore: A dwarf smith with an anvil for a shield. He insists it is a shield.

name: Sir Cogsworth
lore: A knight in a steam-driven suit. Nobody has seen inside it for years.

name: Grisela Ironbraid
lore: Shield-sister of the forge-guard. She braids iron wire into her hair for luck.

name: Ferrum
lore: A forge-golem with a dwarf's heart sealed in its chest. The dwarf volunteered.

name: Breda Hammerfall
lore: She wields a hammer forged from the Last Ember's scraps.

name: Skiv
lore: A tunnel scavenger who knows every crack in Ironhold, and every pocket.

name: Ada Boltwright
lore: Builds repeating crossbows and tests them personally.

name: Marrik Blackpowder
lore: Owns the only firearm in the world. It explodes about half the time.

name: Master Ilgrin
lore: The runesmith of Ironhold who reforged the Last Ember.

name: Sister Kettle
lore: A forge-priestess who blesses weapons by hitting them.

name: Doctor Halvard
lore: A field surgeon who has taken off forty legs and saved forty lives.

name: Brother Aldous
lore: A monk who took a vow of silence and a vow of violence.

name: Dame Ysmay
lore: A knight of House Vey who refused the blood. They took her family instead.

name: Lucan Stake
lore: He hunts House Vey with silver and spite.

name: Mira Silvershot
lore: Her arrows are melted-down abbey candlesticks. Vex is jealous.

name: Garrick Nightwatch
lore: He watched the abbey walls for twenty years. The one night he slept, it fell.

name: Severin Vey
lore: A son of House Vey who turned blood magic against his mother.

name: Agna of the Thousand Candles
lore: She lights a candle for every soul the abbey lost. Each one burns.

name: Acolyte Tess
lore: The Weeping Saint's last acolyte. She still hears the Saint cry.

name: Inquisitor Maud
lore: She burned witches for the Church. Now she hunts the vampires who corrupted it.

name: Old Benedikt
lore: He keeps the abbey graves. Lately he has to keep them closed.

name: Cantor Amsel
lore: He leads a choir of ghosts. Two of them are still alive.

name: Sister Agathe
lore: She has stitched more wounds than any surgeon, and prays while she sews.

name: The Pale Sentinel
lore: A Warden's armor walking without a Warden. It answers to the Hundred.

name: Kestrel Riftguard
lore: Stands at the edge of the Rift every night and pushes things back in.

name: Aurelian, Last Oath
lore: A Warden's grandson who took his grandfather's oath and shield.

name: Nyx Riftblade
lore: She cut a hole in the Hollow with her sword. Something cut back.

name: Teague the Turncloak
lore: Once Malrec's bodyguard. He knows every trick his master taught him, and hates them all.

name: Brannagh Doomsworn
lore: Sworn to die at the Throne. She intends to be late.

name: Vespera Starshot
lore: She fires arrows of starlight. The stars are running out.

name: Rhys Voidhunter
lore: He hunts Hollow-spawn for bounty. The bounty-payers are all dead.

name: Aerin Greywillow
lore: Lyra's mother, lost in the Hollow ten years ago. Found.

name: Magister Quell
lore: The last Archmage, now that Ilvane is gone. He did not want the job.

name: Corra the Penitent
lore: Ilvane's sister. She came to the Throne to finish what her sister started, or undo it.

name: Ostra Hourglass
lore: She steals seconds from her enemies and gives them to her friends.

name: Lisbet Inkoath
lore: Corvin's apprentice. She writes down every oath of the Hundred, in her own blood.

name: Sunniva Lightbearer
lore: She carries the last lantern from the abbey into the dark.

name: Wen Mendwell
lore: A healer who learned to cure the Hollow-touched by taking the Hollow into herself.
